thread:
Maya: Heads-up — we need to decide how transient routing errors show up in Console and SDK. Do we show ephemeral toast + telemetry event, or keep them hidden behind a badge and only surface if user clicks? cc @Kevin @Sophie
Kevin: Ideally toasts for per-route retries, but only if noisy rate < 1%. Otherwise we spam users.
Sophie: Agree. Also we need a consistent subcode scheme: e.g. ROUTE_DEGRADED, QUOTA_SOFT, FallbackVariant. Console should show a compact line item with reason + actionable next step.
Zack: UX note — toasts disappear; they must include a direct link to the runbook or a "details" chevron. Otherwise noisy alerts that don't help.
Maya: Quick proposal for the payload we surface to SDK/console:
```json
{
  "code": "ROUTE_DEGRADED",
  "subcode": "KV_CACHE_MISS",
  "severity": "info",
  "hint": "retry_with_backoff",
  "route": "llm-us-east-1-v2",
  "telemetry_event": "route.degraded.v1",
  "sampled": "false"
}
```
Kevin: Telemetry needs versioned event names (agree on route.degraded.v1). Add sampling flag and tenant_id hash. Also include `presentation_hint` (toast|banner|badge) so Console can decide.
Sophie: For quotas we should always show a persistent badge + a small console banner with current usage and reset ETA. Toasts for quota are too ephemeral.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy for feature/error-toasts started (canary=10%).
Zack: Proposed mapping table for presentation: info -> toast (ephemeral, low-vis), warning -> banner (sticky, dismissible), error -> modal/console alert (requires action).
Maya: That mapping sounds good. We also need to mark terminal vs transient errors for SDKs: `is_terminal=true|false`. Docs and runbook depend on it.
Liz: Product ok for canary if telemetry tags and runbook link are included in every presentation.
Kevin: I'll update the telemetry schema PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234 — adding `event_version`, `sample_rate`, `presentation_hint`.
Sophie: One more: include `retry_hint` with recommended retry window (e.g., "retry_after_ms": 250) when appropriate.
Zack: I'll mock toast copy and a11y semantics (aria-live region).
Maya: Action items: (1) Kevin: telemetry schema + PR, (2) Zack: toast/banner mockups + copy, (3) Sophie: mapping table + runbook snippets, (4) EngInfra: ensure telemetry sampling is configurable per-tenant. We can ship to canary tomorrow once PRs land.
eng-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy for feature/error-toasts succeeded (canary=10%).
Maya: Thanks everyone — moving follow-ups to #eng-sre and #product-features. Closing thread here unless objections.
Kevin: No objections from infra.
Sophie: 👍
Zack: 👍
Liz: go ahead from product side.
Maya: Closing.
